description: Datapublica is a database of all Danish companies and people with official roles. Inspect ownership, director roles, financials, filings, capital events. This plugin lets ChatGPT run advanced SQL queries across the full dataset so it is able to do data analysis and find unique insights, such as rankings, comparisons, aggregations, and trends.
